== Notes ==
*You can still get the '''Perfect''' achievement if you lose HP from your own cards during a boss combat.
*You can still obtain the '''Minimalist''' achievement if your deck becomes 5 cards after [[Act 3]].

== Tips ==
*'''Adrenaline''' can be easy to get using cards that generate {{KW|Energy}}, such as {{C|Adrenaline}}, {{C|TURBO}}, {{C|Collect}}, {{C|Deva Form}}, or by using {{R|Ice Cream}}, which conserves {{KW|Energy}} between turns. 
*'''The Pact''' can be earned in combats where the enemies applies many [[Statuses]], such as the fight with the [[Sentry|Sentries]], or use any combo of {{C|Corruption}} with {{R|Dead Branch}} and/or {{C|Dark Embrace}}.
*To earn the '''Purity''' achievement, you either need a constant source of {{KW|Exhaust|Exhausting}}, or a minimalist deck with some {{KW|Exhaust}} cards. 
**Facing the [[Bronze Automaton]] in [[Act 2]] may also help, as the Bronze Orbs will temporarily remove two cards from your deck.
*The '''Impervious''' and '''Barricaded''' achievements can be earned with any source of {{KW|Block}} and a way to conserve it between turns, such as {{C|Barricade}}. {{C|Entrench}} makes these achievements much easier and less tedious.
*{{R|Peace Pipe}} makes the '''Minimalist''' challenge easier, as you are given many more card removal opportunities with it.
*Killing the boss on turn 1 for the '''You Are Nothing''' achievement requires a large amount of damage to be done in a single turn. Consider using a highly upgraded {{C|Searing Blow}}, boosters like {{C|Offering}}/{{C|Adrenaline}}/[[Potions]], or an "infinite" deck.
**Killing the [[Awakened One|Awakened One's]] first phase in one turn counts for getting the achievement.
*The '''Come At Me''' achievement is easily earned with {{KW|Thorns}}, {{KW|Poison}}, or by playing [[The Defect]] and letting [[Orbs]] chip away.
**Taking {{R|Neow's Lament}} on [[The Defect]], combined with [[Orbs]] is an easy way to get this achievement
*The '''Catalyst''' achievement, as its name implies, is simplified with the use of {{C|Catalyst}}.
*The [[Transient|'''Transient''']] is more or less a hard version of "''You are nothing''". Any build that scales quickly, e.g. via the use of {{C|Catalyst}}, {{C|Limit Break}}, rapid {{KW|Mantra}} generation for a consistent {{KW|Divinity}} or infinite one-turn killer combo, may beat it.
*'''Neon''' is best earned through the use of {{C|Meteor Strike}} and a way to play it multiple times in one turn, such as {{C|Echo Form}} and/or {{C|Hologram}}.
*Both '''Focused''' and '''Powerful''' are best earned with {{C|Creative AI}} as a continuous source of [[powers]].
**'''Focused''' can also be earned through the use of {{C|Consume}}, but will require many orb slots. Best coupled with {{R|Inserter}}.
*An "infinite" deck containing cards such as {{C|Flash of Steel}}, {{C|Dropkick}} or {{C|Heel Hook}} will make many achievements simple. An infinite can also be built with cards such as {{C|Tactician}} or an {{R|Unceasing Top}} but a deck like this may take longer to kill enemies.
